hero.subtitle: A modular, skill-oriented framework for AI agents. Low token, high signal. Architecture first, code second.

about.title: What is IzanagiIA?
about.desc: IzanagiIA is a meta-framework — a set of instructions for AI agents that standardizes quality, security, and efficiency. Unlike common libraries, IzanagiIA organizes agent behavior in layers: every task passes through decision, context, skill execution, quality, reflection, and memory engines. The result? Agents that evolve on their own, spend fewer tokens, and produce cleaner code.

features.title: Modular by Design
features.subtitle: Eight engines working together. Each one purpose-built, replaceable, and measurable.

decision.title: Decision Engine
decision.desc: Classifies tasks, routes to the right skill chain, and prioritizes with precision.

context.title: Context Engine
context.desc: Builds minimal context windows, loads relevant memory, and eliminates noise before the agent thinks.

token.title: Token Manager
token.desc: Monitors budgets in real time. Triggers compression at 70%+ usage. Keeps responses lean.

quality.title: Quality Gates
quality.desc: Five-layer validation: Security → Style → Clarity → Conciseness → Completeness.

reflection.title: Reflection Engine
reflection.desc: Self-review after every task. Logs mistakes, captures improvements, feeds the evolution cycle.

evolution.title: Evolution Engine
evolution.desc: Skills upgrade themselves over time. The framework improves with every task, autonomously.

install.title: Start in Seconds
install.subtitle: Install via npm, create an agent, and start building.

architecture.title: Layered Architecture
architecture.subtitle: Every interaction passes through an engine pipeline that ensures quality, security, and clarity.

cta.subtitle: Start building with IzanagiIA. Zero config, full control.
